subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this focused fresh-session fallback land now while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 tracks reattach-first recovery, or should this PR pause and be expanded into that layered design first?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but they differ in user-visible disconnect semantics: this PR avoids same-session transcript collision while preserving the existing timeout-style duplicate-execution boundary.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path, document the new metadata reason, and keep the reattach-first design as follow-up work.

options.title: Expand to reattach-first
options.body: Pause this PR and require the branch to reconnect and wait for the accepted gateway run before falling back to a fresh embedded session.

options.title: Leave current behavior
options.body: Close or hold the PR if maintainers prefer not to change accepted-disconnect fallback semantics without a full recovery redesign.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path, document the new metadata reason, and keep the reattach-first design as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway/session lifecycle commits make this the strongest routing signal for the product boundary decision.
